Tokyo Garden Hotel.text: Perfectly quiet and close to the station. Exactly what I needed for a short business trip.
Clean rooms, good AC, and breakfast was simple but solid. Gym was small but did the job.
Nothing fancy but reliable. The crib for our baby was a nice touch, staff set it up quickly.
Loved how easy it was to get around from here. Accessible rooms were genuinely well thought out.
Fine for the price, but a bit dated. Laundry room was convenient for a longer stay.
Great value. Breakfast included and the gym had enough to get a quick workout in each morning.
Room was smaller than expected, but everything was clean and functional.
Staff were incredibly helpful with directions and recommendations nearby.
Good quiet stay. Wish there was a pool, but the gym covered the basics.
Solid, no-nonsense hotel. Would stay again for a work trip.

Tokyo Premier Hotel - Shibuya.text: The spa was a wonderful surprise after a long day of walking around Shibuya.
Balcony view over the city at night was stunning. Worth every yen.
Airport shuttle made arrival so much easier after a long flight.
Breakfast spread was excellent and the gym was properly equipped, not an afterthought.
Great location right in the middle of everything, though it can get noisy at night.
Accessible room was thoughtfully designed, made travel so much easier for my mother.
Spa treatment was relaxing, and the balcony was a nice place to unwind with coffee.
Good hotel but pricier than expected for what you get. Still enjoyed the shuttle service.
Premier really lives up to the name. Everything felt a step above the usual Shibuya hotel.
Gym and spa combo made this a great stay after a busy conference schedule.

Lovely Yokohama.text: They welcomed our dog with genuine enthusiasm — even had a little treat waiting at check-in.
Having a kitchen made the stay so much easier with two young kids. Cribs were provided too.
Such a charming, thematic place. Felt more like staying in a real home than a hotel.
Free parking was a lifesaver since we drove down from Tokyo with our pet.
Best pet-friendly stay we've had in Japan. Our dog was treated like a guest, not an inconvenience.
No gym or pool, but honestly didn't miss it — the balcony view and kitchen made up for it.
Breakfast included and genuinely good. Loved the balcony overlooking the harbor.
Great family spot. Kitchen let us cook for the kids instead of eating out every meal.
Staff clearly love animals here — went out of their way to recommend nearby dog-friendly parks.
A bit out of the way but worth it for the space and the warm welcome for our pet.

Shibuya Stack Hotel.text: Loved the pool after a long day exploring Shibuya. Rooftop views were incredible.
They let us bring our cat with zero hassle. Genuinely the most pet-friendly hotel we've stayed at in Tokyo.
Spa and gym combo made this feel like a proper mini-retreat, not just a place to sleep.
Very posh, design-forward interior. Small rooms but clever use of space.
Pool was smaller than I expected but the spa more than made up for it.
Brought our dog along and the staff had water bowls ready without us even asking.
Gym was compact but modern, and the pool area had a great atmosphere at sunset.
Stylish but a bit pricey for the room size. Still enjoyed the spa a lot.
Perfect pet-friendly stay — pool, spa, and gym all in one, plus they adored our dog.
Concept hotel done right. The pool and spa were the highlight of our trip.
